headline: AI demand drives momentum; Advantech expects Q3 revenue to rise both quarter-on-quarter and year-on-year, with gross margin stable | Securities
summary: Industrial computer maker Advantech told investors that AI-related demand keeps order momentum high. It expects third-quarter revenue to rise both quarter-on-quarter and year-on-year, with gross margin stable.
why: Advantech is a Taiwan-based maker of industrial computers and embedded systems, so its orders reflect demand for industrial and AI-related computing hardware.
